## Goal: test data simulations

## This script runs simulations on applicant data to determine most likely job title and city

## Define simulation parameters
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

Candidates <- read.csv("School_Front (3-30).csv")

set.seed(123)
runs <- 1000

cities <- c("Canandaigua", "Rochester")

jobs   <- c("Certified Positions (Misc)", "Assistant Principal",
            "HR Assistant", "Teaching Assistant")

n_candidates <- nrow(Candidates)

```

## Randomly assign a city and job to each candidate
```{r}

sim_results <- list()

for (i in 1:runs) {

assigned_city <- sample(cities, n_candidates, replace = TRUE)
assigned_job  <- sample(jobs, n_candidates, replace = TRUE)

 # Count how many candidates fall into each city/job combination
  for (city in cities) {
    for (job in jobs) {
      count <- sum(assigned_city == city & assigned_job == job)
      
      sim_results[[length(sim_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Simulation = i,
        City       = city,
        Job        = job,
        Count      = count
      )
    }
  }
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
sim_results_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(sim_results)

```

## No loops option
```{r}

sim_list <- replicate(
  runs,
  {
    assigned_city <- sample(cities, n_candidates, replace = TRUE)
    assigned_job  <- sample(jobs, n_candidates, replace = TRUE)
    as.data.frame(table(assigned_city, assigned_job))
  },
  simplify = FALSE
)

sim_results_df <- bind_rows(sim_list, .id = "Simulation")

# Optional: rename columns for clarity
sim_results_df <- sim_results_df %>%
  rename(
    City  = assigned_city,
    Job   = assigned_job,
    Count = Freq
  )

sim_results_df %>%
  group_by(City, Job) %>%
  summarise(Average_Count = mean(Count), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}

sim_results_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(City, Job) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Average_Count = mean(Count))

```
